name: Spring Winds
source:
Welcome to Fujiwara academy! You, Akari Fujioka, are the (somewhat unwilling) newest member of the Mystery club.  While there are plenty of questions to answer on academy grounds, the most difficult to answer are the ones in your own heart. Solve mysteries and choose your own path in this branching visual novel, and make friends along the way!

[From [url=https://rainmirage.itch.io/spring-winds]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到藤原学园！你是藤冈明里，是刚加入推理社的新成员（虽然有点不情愿）。校内有很多谜题等着解开，但最难回答的，还是你内心的问题。解开谜团，在这部多路线视觉小说中选择自己的道路，并一路结交朋友！

[来源：[url=https://rainmirage.itch.io/spring-winds]Itch.io[/url]]
